app.name: NithiDesk
date.inputHint: Pick the date from the calendar
nav.label: Main
search.label: Search matters and cases
search.placeholder: Case number, matter or party name
search.none: Nothing found. Try the case number without spaces, or part of a name.
search.matched.title: title
offline.banner: You are offline. Outcomes and notes you save are kept on this device and sent when you reconnect.
login.title: Sign in
login.firmHint: Only needed if your firm gave you one.
login.otherFirm: Sign in to a different firm
login.reason.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.reason.network: NithiDesk could not reach the server. Check your connection and sign in.
login.queueWaiting: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} waiting to send from this device. Sign in to send {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
mfa.enroll.title: Set up two-step sign-in
mfa.enroll.body: Scan this code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.enroll.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.enroll.manual: Can’t scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
mfa.recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
mfa.recovery.body: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Write them down or store them somewhere safe.
mfa.recovery.once: These codes are shown only once.
mfa.verify.title: Enter your code
mfa.verify.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for NithiDesk.
mfa.verify.recoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in.
pin.title: Quick unlock PIN
pin.label: PIN
pin.explain: On this phone, a 4–8 digit PIN reopens NithiDesk after a short break without your password.
pin.hasPin: A PIN is set for this phone. Set a new one to replace it.
pin.unlock.title: Unlock NithiDesk
pin.unlock.body: NithiDesk locked after a break. Enter your PIN to continue.
stepUp.title: Confirm it’s you
stepUp.body: This action needs your password and a fresh authenticator code.
logout.pendingBody: {count, plural, one {# outcome or note has} other {# outcomes or notes have}} not reached the server. Signing out deletes {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} from this device.
scope.label: Whose hearings
today.badge.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# date conflict} other {# date conflicts}}
today.badge.notRecorded: {count, plural, one {# outcome} other {# outcomes}} not recorded
today.emptyMine: You are not appearing in any hearing on this day.
court.label: Court
hearing.conflictExplain: Two sources give different dates for this hearing. Check the case record and verify the right date.
hearing.queuedHere: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} for this hearing {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} waiting to send.
hearing.timeHint: Leave empty if the court gave no time.
hearing.dateSourceHint: Where did this date come from? This decides how far it can be trusted.
hearing.sourceDetailHint: For example the journal entry number, list date or who told you.
party.name: Name
matter.label: Matter
matter.confidentialityHint: Restricted matters are visible only to the team.
matter.teamHint: Choose exactly one responsible partner. You join as lead if no lead is chosen.
user.name: Name
entity.searchHint: Type a name in English or Sinhala. Similar names in the other script are found too.
entity.createNew: Add a new person or organisation
proceeding.none: No cases in this matter yet.
caseNumber.label: Case number
caseNumber.optional: Leave empty if the court has not given a number yet.
link.noOthers: This matter has no other case to link to. Add the other case first.
link.explain: Link {caseNo} to another case in this matter, for example an appeal.
hearingNew.title: Add hearing
note.title: Add note
note.label: Note
note.hint: Visible to the matter team only.
verify.title: Verify the date
verify.confirming: You are confirming that the hearing is on {date}.
verify.evidenceHint: For example: JE 24 on 12/10, or court list of 13/10
verify.noAssertion: This hearing has no date to verify.
assert.title: Correct the date
assert.body: Use this when the date was recorded wrongly. The old entry is kept; the hearing shows “Dates disagree” until someone verifies.
vacate.title: The court changed the date
vacate.body: Use this when the case was re-dated before the day (notice, motion, court not sitting). This hearing is closed and a replacement hearing is created.
listingAction.held.title: Hearing took place
listingAction.held.body: Mark the hearing as held now; record the outcome when you have the details.
listingAction.not_reached.title: Not reached
listingAction.not_reached.body: The court sat but did not take up this case. You will still need to record the next date.
listingAction.court_not_sitting.title: Court not sitting
listingAction.court_not_sitting.body: The court did not sit (holiday, judge absent, strike). You will still need to record the next date.
listingAction.cancelled.title: Cancel this hearing
listingAction.cancelled.body: Only for hearings that are no longer listed at all, such as a wrong entry or a withdrawn case.
outcome.title: Outcome · {caseNo}
outcome.orderTextHint: Optional. For example: Plaintiff to tender P5–P9.
outcome.hasNext: The court gave a next date
outcome.noNextReason: Why there is no next date
outcome.noNext.date_from_registry: Date to be obtained from the registry
outcome.unverifiedNote: The next date is saved as “Not verified” until the clerk checks the case record.
outcome.savedWithNext: Outcome saved. Next hearing on {date} (not verified yet).
outcome.err.reason: Choose why there is no next date.
outcome.warn.past: The next date is in the past.
outcome.warn.weekend: The next date is a Saturday or Sunday.
outcome.warn.notAfter: The next date must be after this hearing’s date.
outcome.warn.calendar.public_holiday: The next date is a public holiday: {label}
outcome.warn.calendar.poya: The next date is a Poya day: {label}
outcome.warn.calendar.vacation: The next date falls in the court vacation: {label}
outcome.warn.calendar.not_sitting: The court is marked as not sitting on that date: {label}
queue.explain: Outcomes and notes saved on this device that have not reached the server yet. They are sent automatically when you are back online.
queue.empty: Nothing is waiting. Everything you saved has been sent.
queue.savedWaiting: Saved on this device. Waiting to send.
queue.status.waiting_auth: Waiting to send — unlock or sign in
queue.expiresSoon: This item expires within 3 hours. Connect to the internet so it can be sent.
queue.expiredExplain: This item was not sent within 24 hours and its contents were removed from this device. Record it again.
queue.discardConfirm: Delete this item from this device? It has not been sent.
outcomesPending.explain: Past hearings with no outcome. Each one may be a missed next date — this list should be empty.
outcomesPending.empty: Every past hearing has an outcome.
verifyQueue.explain: Hearings in the next 30 days whose date is not yet confirmed from the case record or court list.
verifyQueue.differentExplain: Record the date the record or list shows. The hearing will show “Dates disagree” until it is verified.
courtList.explain: Enter the case numbers on the court’s list. NithiDesk compares them with our diary for that court and date.
courtList.numbersHint: One per line. {count, plural, =0 {None entered yet.} one {# entered.} other {# entered.}}
courtList.sourceDetailHint: Optional. For example: notice board list, 12/10
courtList.matched: On the list and in our diary
courtList.different: On the list for a different date
courtList.differentExplain: The list date was recorded on these hearings; they now show “Dates disagree”.
courtList.missing: In our diary but not on the list
courtList.missingExplain: Check with the registry whether these cases are listed.
courtList.unexpected: On the list but not in our diary
courtList.unexpectedExplain: Possible missed dates. Find the matter and add the hearing.
brief.failed: The PDF could not be prepared. Try again.
import.explain: Bring an existing court diary into NithiDesk from a spreadsheet.
import.templateExplain: Fill one row per hearing. Keep the column names; dates as YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
import.fileHint: Save as CSV UTF-8 so Sinhala text is kept.
import.commit: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
import.rollbackConfirm: Undo this import? Everything it created is removed.
import.fixErrors: Fix the rows with errors in the file and upload it again before importing.
importcode.reference.unknown: This value is not in the list NithiDesk knows.
importcode.case_number.possible_duplicat: This case number may already exist.
importcode.case_number.unusual_format: The case number does not look like this court’s usual format.
importcode.hearing.date_in_past: The hearing date is in the past.
importcode.hearing.date_on_weekend: The hearing date is a weekend.
importcode.user.unknown: No user with this name or email.
admin.disableConfirm: Disable this account? The user is signed out everywhere at once.
admin.resetMfaConfirm: Reset two-step sign-in? The user sets it up again at the next sign-in.
admin.selfNote: You cannot disable your own account.
settings.labelModeHint: With Sinhala, also show the English term next to each label, for example “නඩු අංකය / Case number”.
password.title: Change password
password.policy: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easier to remember.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
warning.hearing.date_in_past: The date is in the past.
warning.hearing.date_on_weekend: The date is a Saturday or Sunday.
warning.hearing.date_on_public_holiday: The date is a public holiday: {label}
warning.hearing.date_on_poya: The date is a Poya day: {label}
warning.hearing.date_on_vacation: The date falls in the court vacation: {label}
warning.hearing.date_on_not_sitting: The court is marked as not sitting that day: {label}
warning.hearing.appearance_clash: {name} has another hearing at a different court in the same session.
warning.case_number.unusual_format: This case number does not match the court’s usual format ({example}). Check it.
warning.case_number.possible_duplicate: This case number is already used in matter {matter_number}. Check it is not the same case.
warning.case_number.possible_duplicate_h: This case number may already be used in a matter you cannot see. Ask a partner.
error.generic: Something went wrong. If it keeps happening, give this reference to your administrator: {requestId}
error.unexpected: Something went wrong on this device. Reload the page and try again.
error.network: No connection to NithiDesk. Check your internet and try again.
error.internal_error: The server could not complete this. Try again in a moment.
error.not_found: Not found. It may have been removed, or you may not have access.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.request.malformed: The request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
error.forbidden.capability: Your role does not allow this.
error.precondition.version_mismatch: Someone else changed this while you were working. The latest version has been loaded — check it and try again.
error.precondition.required: The app sent an incomplete request. Reload and try again.
error.idempotency.key_reused: This was already sent with different details. Reload and try again.
error.idempotency.in_progress: This is still being saved. Wait a moment.
error.auth.session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
error.auth.session_locked: NithiDesk is locked. Enter your PIN.
error.auth.step_up_required: Confirm your password and code to continue.
error.auth.invalid_credentials: Email or password is not correct.
error.auth.account_locked: This account is locked after too many attempts. Try again later or ask your administrator.
error.auth.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Codes change every 30 seconds — try the current one.
error.auth.mfa_already_enrolled: Two-step sign-in is already set up for this account.
error.auth.csrf_invalid: Your session check failed. Reload the page.
error.auth.pin_mobile_only: A PIN can only be set on a phone.
error.hearing.date_change_requires_asser: A date is changed by recording where the new date came from.
error.hearing.illegal_transition: This hearing cannot be changed that way in its current state.
error.hearing.outcome_requires_next_or_r: Give the next date, or say why there is none.
error.hearing.outcome_before_date: The outcome can be recorded only on or after the hearing date.
error.hearing.outcome_already_recorded: Someone has already recorded the outcome for this hearing. Open the hearing to check it.
error.hearing.appearing_user_not_on_team: The appearing lawyer must be on the matter team.
error.verification.assertion_not_current: The date changed since you opened this. Reload and verify the current date.
error.verification.source_not_authoritat: A date can be verified only from the case record, a certified order or an official court list.
error.wall.member_excluded: This person is behind an ethical wall for this matter.
error.user.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
error.user.cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
error.matter.team_role_taken: Someone already has this role on the matter.
error.matter.already_member: This person is already on the team.
error.matter.responsible_partner_require: A matter must keep one responsible partner.
error.party.ordinal_taken: Another party already has this number in this role.
error.proceeding.relationship_cycle: This link would make a loop between cases.
error.proceeding.relationship_exists: These cases are already linked this way.
error.proceeding.has_history: This case has hearings and cannot be deleted.
fieldcode.type.invalid: This value has the wrong type.
fieldcode.uuid.invalid: Choose an item from the list.
fieldcode.reference.unknown: Choose an item from the list.
fieldcode.password.too_common: This password is too common. Choose another.
fieldcode.password.contains_email: Do not use your email in the password.
fieldcode.matter.one_lead: Choose at most one lead lawyer.
fieldcode.entity.unknown: This person or organisation was not found.
fieldcode.member.not_eligible: This person cannot join the team.
fieldcode.hearing.next_date_not_after: The next date must be after this hearing’s date.
fieldcode.proceeding.self_link: A case cannot be linked to itself.
fieldcode.proceeding.not_in_matter: Choose a case in this matter.
fieldcode.matter.lifecycle_transition_no: The matter cannot move to that state now.
fieldcode.code.invalid: Use lower-case letters, numbers and underscores.
error.import.not_validatable: This import can no longer be checked.
error.import.has_errors: Some rows still have errors. Fix them in the file and upload it again.
error.import.row_failed: A row could not be imported, so nothing was imported. Check the report and try again.
error.import.not_committed: Only an import that was completed can be undone.
error.import.rollback_blocked: This import cannot be undone: some of its records have been changed since.
fieldcode.import.not_utf8: Save the file as CSV UTF-8 and upload it again.
fieldcode.import.no_header: The file has no header row. Start from the template.
fieldcode.import.missing_column: The column “{column}” is missing. Start from the template.
fieldcode.import.csv_malformed: The file could not be read near row {row}.
fieldcode.import.too_many_rows: Too many rows. Split the file into parts of at most {max} rows.
importcode.import.duplicate_hearing_row: The same hearing appears more than once in the file.
importcode.import.existing_proceeding: This case already exists; the hearing is added to it.
importcode.import.no_migrated_source: The date source “Migrated from diary” is missing in reference data.
importcode.import.warn.no_case_number: No case number: this hearing cannot be matched against court lists.
importcode.case_number.exists_elsewhere: This case number already exists in another matter.
prep.title: Preparation and instructions
prep.noteHint: For example what is missing, or why it is blocked.
